sloka: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य मुष्टिना ऽभिजघान ह।मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतं तच्छैलाग्रं व्यशीर्यत ।। ६.६७.२३ ।।
transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ samprekṣya muṣṭinā 'bhijaghāna ha।muṣṭiprahārābhihataṁ tacchailāgraṁ vyaśīryata ।। 6.67.23 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasa's army collected together rejoiced to see Hanuman agonized. Vanaras were frightened and fled in fear of Kumbhakarna.
